latin: Ideo Moysis sepulchrum nemo nouit, quia exaltatus est in Iobeleo superiore, et super Iobeleum misit radices suas.
translation: Nobody knew where Moses was entombed, because he had been lifted into the higher Jubilee and had sent his roots beyond that Jubilee.
